label: Mean luminance
quantity: Mean luminance (exposure level; Rec. 709 Y, 0 to 1)

label: Sharpness (Tenengrad)
quantity: Sharpness (mean squared Sobel gradient of luminance)

label: Under-exposed fraction
quantity: Under-exposed area (fraction of pixels with Y below 0.10)

label: Saturated fraction
quantity: Saturated area (fraction of pixels with any channel at or above 0.98)

label: Haze (dark channel)
quantity: Haze or turbidity (mean dark channel, 15 px patch)

label: Illumination fall-off
quantity: Illumination fall-off (slope of luminance against normalised radius)

label: Luminance entropy
quantity: Tonal information (Shannon entropy of luminance, bits)
